searchText: could you make me a branch where you don't even do that? I'm trying to test a client that only does ms in the spec too and validate that our tooling would be able to handle it https://github.com/ChainSafe/lodestar/tree/rm-rf-seconds-per-slot image building thank you ser looks like you don't do any logic just hard coded the seconds per slot to 12 and 6 😄 its probably fine e.g if someone does this: ``` network_params: preset: minimal seconds_per_slot: 5 ``` without the rm-rf-seconds-per-slot you gonna get 5000 and 6 in the spec api the only logic we apply is this ```ts // Set SLOT_DURATION_MS if SECONDS_PER_SLOT is provided but SLOT_DURATION_MS is not. // This is to provide backward compatibility until Gloas is live if (input.SLOT_DURATION_MS === undefined) { config.SLOT_DURATION_MS = config.SECONDS_PER_SLOT * 1000; } ``` if you set `SLOT_DURATION_MS` explicitly it well be used, but we don't override `SECONDS_PER_SLOT` with that value as it's not used
